# Qiao Partners

> Independent China–Europe advisory firm helping Chinese companies enter, establish and grow across European markets through strategic advisory, market intelligence, commercial partnerships and European representation.

Qiao Partners is an independent China–Europe market entry and strategic business development firm based in Warsaw, Poland. It helps Chinese companies enter, establish and grow across European markets, and supports selected European companies entering China. It is not a law firm, tax adviser, certification body or investment adviser, and it does not invest or give investment advice.

## Services
- [Strategic Advisory & Market Intelligence](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#strategic-advisory): We assess the European opportunity for your products: demand, competition, pricing, regulation and market access, country by country. The result is a clear recommendation on whether, where and how to enter.
- [Market Entry & Establishment](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#market-entry): We design the entry model, whether distributor, partner, direct sales or your own entity, and coordinate the practical steps to operate in Europe with qualified legal, tax and certification specialists.
- [Commercial Development & Partnerships](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#commercial-development): We identify and approach European buyers, distributors and commercial partners, arrange qualified meetings and support you through negotiation towards commercial agreements.
- [European Representation & Expansion](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#european-representation): We act as your external European business development and strategic coordination partner: representing your company locally, managing partner relationships, coordinating stakeholders and keeping headquarters informed as you expand across countries.

## Industries
- Industrial Technology & Advanced Manufacturing: Industrial automation, Robotics, Machinery, Industrial components, Advanced materials, Manufacturing technologies
- Energy & Infrastructure: Battery energy storage systems, Battery technologies, Solar, Power electronics, Transformers and grid infrastructure, Renewable energy equipment, Biomethane technologies, Industrial energy systems
- Mobility & Automotive: Automotive components, EV supply chains, Commercial vehicles, Charging infrastructure, Battery components, Mobility technologies
- Digital & Critical Infrastructure: AI data-centre infrastructure, Data-centre cooling, Power distribution, Industrial digitalisation, Selected technology infrastructure
